summary: Iteration 117: chat UI enhancements (mark-read, reply, stop-AI, doc reading) verified across shared backend + web + mobile (Expo web preview). Backend 7/7 pytest passed. Web reply flow (menu→reply-preview→send→reply-quote) works end-to-end. Web + mobile show 'AI is thinking… Stop' indicator on long @ai prompts, and backend correctly discards the answer on stop. However, on BOTH web and mobile the client-side ai-thinking-indicator does NOT disappear immediately after the user taps Stop (still visible >1.5s later) — likely a websocket/local-state refresh gap. Mobile message bubbles are missing per-message testIDs, which blocked automated long-press → reply testing on mobile (bug in testability; real users unaffected). Mark-as-read verified at backend level; UI baseline had unread=0 so no visual regression observed. Leave-chat regression 200 OK.

ui_bugs.issue: ai-thinking-indicator persists in the DOM for >1.5s after user clicks stop-ai-btn. Backend confirms the ai_question placeholder is soft-deleted and broadcast via WS, but the web client does not clear the indicator immediately. Real user perception is that Stop 'didn't work' even though the answer is discarded. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/chat/MessageList.jsx:159-170

Individual chat message bubbles have NO testID={`message-${id}`} attribute. Only reply-quote-<id> is testable. This blocks automated long-press testing of the Reply flow on mobile and is a parity gap with web (web has data-testid={`message-${id}`}). Reference: /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx (renderItem — no testID on the outer row/pressable).

Same behavior as web: after tapping stop-ai-btn, ai-thinking-indicator remains visible on-screen (>2s wait). Backend cancellation succeeds (canceled>0, placeholder deleted) but the mobile view keeps rendering the thinking row. Reference: /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx:583-586

parity_issues.issue: After Stop is clicked, the ai-thinking-indicator stays rendered on both web and mobile even though the backend has canceled the thread and soft-deleted the ai_question placeholder.
parity_issues.expected: Indicator disappears within ~500ms of clicking Stop (matching backend soft-delete broadcast).
parity_issues.actual: Indicator visible >1.5s later on both surfaces; user has to send another message or navigate away for it to clear.

parity_issues.issue: Web message bubbles expose data-testid=`message-<id>` (used for right-click / hover). Mobile does not expose a matching testID on message rows, so long-press → msg-action-modal → Reply cannot be reached deterministically by automation, unlike on web.
parity_issues.expected: Mobile renders testID=`message-<id>` on the outer Pressable/View for each message (parity with web).
parity_issues.actual: Mobile only tags nested elements (reply-quote-<id>, followups-<id>, etc.). Outer message row has no testID.

action_items: WEB: After POST /api/chats/{id}/ai/stop resolves (and/or on receiving message_updated WS event with deleted_at), immediately clear the local `aiThinking` state / hide ai-thinking-indicator instead of waiting for the next poll. Consider optimistically setting `isThinking=false` inside the Stop click handler.
MOBILE: Same fix on /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx — set the thinking flag off within the stopAI() handler right after the POST resolves, not only on WS event.

MOBILE: Add testID={`message-${item.id}`} to the outer Pressable/View in renderItem of /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx so automation + long-press flows can target individual messages (parity with web MessageBubble).
OPTIONAL: Consider adding a subtle 'AI stopped' toast on both surfaces so users get positive confirmation instead of just the indicator vanishing.
critical_code_review_comments: chats.py POST /chats/{id}/ai/stop already broadcasts message_updated on placeholder soft-delete — good. Client-side listeners on both platforms need to react to that event OR to the POST response by clearing the local thinking flag.
Mobile chat/[id].tsx exposes lots of nested testIDs but skips the most important one (message row). This has been reported before but resurfaced this iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend flow for iteration 117 (mark-read, ai/stop, leave, doc reading) is solid. The remaining work is a client-side state bug on BOTH web and mobile: the ai-thinking-indicator does not disappear after Stop. Also add testID=`message-<id>` to mobile message row to unblock long-press automation. Reply-quote render on web is verified. Mobile reply flow requires the missing testID to fully verify end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Backend chats.py:1287-1300 sets ai_threads status=canceled and broadcasts message_updated for soft-deleted ai_question placeholders — verified via pytest. Client code (Chats.jsx / MessageList.jsx on web, chat/[id].tsx on mobile) apparently keys the 'AI thinking' indicator off a local piece of state that is only cleared when a new ai_answer arrives (or on periodic refetch), not when the placeholder is deleted. Fix: (a) subscribe the client to the message_updated WS event and drop any ai_question with deleted_at from the visible set → immediately hides the indicator; and/or (b) inside stopAI() flip isThinking=false optimistically as soon as POST /ai/stop returns 200.
